reason: Knob is LIVE, but it is a poor use of a slot. Liveness: cell 2 reads BIOHUB_DET_THRESHOLD, cell 4 passes it as --det-threshold to the predict subprocess, and the dual-seed retention guard uses it for the per-frame primary vs blended map switch. Cell 3 does not hard-set it. The builder's main() regex-rewrites the cell-1 guard entry to the --set value, so the old F-MOD-26/G39 'crash at the cell-1 guard' no longer applies. lowrefine keys on READMIT_MIN_SCORE, not DET, and only prints a non-blocking INFO. safetail and divinsert do not read it. Size: the lab exp60 bands give about +0.7% candidates (down) and -1.0% (up), under 1.5% and not negligible. Runtime cost is minutes. Refuted on slot value: (1) imissher 743222 already ran this exact pair (0.960/0.970) on the same detector family and 0.965 default, getting 0.946/0.945 against unmodified 0.946 (v29) and 0.948 (v30). That is already a public two-arm read with no UP either way. (2) Our own reads also show no gain: P04 det 0.95 = 0.940 (neutral), public fork det 0.99 = 0.942 (A29), lab exp07 threshold sweep flat, and R13NC-4 found DET_THRESHOLD 'not a profitable rung'. (3) The down arm uses the same 'admit marginal peaks' mechanism as pending probe 50 (exp85a READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.94 admits [0.94,0.965) peaks next to open ends; 6,303 in the lab). DET 0.96 is a broader, noisier version of that read, and stacking it on exp85a would confound the two. The up arm is roughly READMIT-up (arms_1 rank 1, READMIT 0.99) plus a shrink of the ILP candidate set. (4) The retention-guard switch adds nonlinear noise and gives no reason to expect either sign. Revisit only if both READMIT arms are spent and a slot is left over.
build_line: UP: --set DET_THRESHOLD=0.97 | DOWN: --set DET_THRESHOLD=0.96 (each added to the exp70g recipe: tools/build_probe_kernel.py <name> --base x138 --patch divinsert --patch safetail --patch lowrefine --set DIVINS_ENABLE=1 --set DIVINS_STEAL=1 --set DIVINS_CAP=6 --set DIVINS_FRAME_CAP=1 --set DIVINS_ALPHA=1 --set DIVINS_THRESH=0.4 --set DIVINS_DUMP=0 --set REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=34200 --set DIVINS_DEADLINE_S=28800 --set LOWREFINE_ENABLE=1 --set DEGRADE_KEEP_DIV=1; after the build, grep cell 1 for '"BIOHUB_DET_THRESHOLD": 0.97,' / '0.96,'; ignore the lowrefine 'premise shifts' INFO)
